hypothesis: separating cheap input opportunities from provider advances and adapting advance size to typed revision production can preserve responsiveness while reducing wasted ASR and speculative cognition

adaptive_rule.changed_revision: reset the next provider threshold to 100 ms
adaptive_rule.no_revision: double the next threshold, capped at 400 ms
adaptive_rule.endpoint: flush the remainder and finalize immediately

controlled_fields: complete task/speech populations, seed, timeout, retry, and concurrency
ASR, fast, slow, and TTS model identities and single-GPU placement
canonical trajectory, tool authority, tool resumption, VAD, and speech pacing

analysis.primary: Pareto frontier over pass^1, official interaction metrics, ASR advances, tail latency, and GPU utilization
